description:
FILED s537 (reviewing session, 2026-11-10) from a review probe of s536e (#4545 sibling shape; NOT that batch: main 3139fcb0 and the s536e tree answer the same).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3):

    use feature "signatures"; our @d = (5,6,7);
    sub f ($n = @d, $c = () = @d) { "n=$n c=$c" } print f(), "\n";

perl: `n=3 c=3`.   PCL: `n=ARRAY(0x1) c=ARRAY(0x1)`.  `$n = scalar(@d)`, `$m = (4,5,6)` (6) and `$o = @d + 0` are right.

MECHANISM (read from the emission, not fixed): the default is emitted as a bare value form inside the parameter binding --

    ($n (p-copy-scalar-arg (if (p-arg-supplied-p @_ 0) (aref @_ 0) @d)))

-- so an aggregate-valued default expression reaches the scalar parameter as the aggregate.  perl compiles a scalar parameter default as the RHS of a scalar assignment (`$n = DEFAULT`): scalar context.  Fix shape: lower the default through the same path as `my $n = DEFAULT` (the scalar-assignment RHS: an array is its count, a hash its count / truth, a list assignment its RHS count), ONE path, not a per-shape case; an `@rest` / `%h` slurpy has no default in perl.  Probe also `$n = @$r`, `$n = (@a, @b)` (last element count), `$n = f()` (f called in scalar context -- check wantarray inside), `$n = wantarray` and `//=` / `||=` defaults (5.38).

Bar: guard rows vs perl incl. the wantarray one; corpus-diff + wide A/B (every signature-default site with an aggregate or call default moves; explain each).

=== DONE (s537a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-10 .. 11-13; commit 478d582d on the s537a branch, rebased over MAIN-READY-87; shas as of the rebase over main b620405f) ===
FIXED: a scalar signature parameter's DEFAULT is lowered as the RHS of `my $n = DEFAULT` -- `Pl/Parser.pm` `_compile_default_expr` annotates it SCALAR (an array default is its count, `() = LIST` its RHS count, a call sees wantarray false) and a TAKEN default is stored by `p-box-init`; a supplied argument keeps `p-copy-scalar-arg`.  `sub f ($n = @d)` binds the count (perl), not the array.  Emission change at every signature default (corpus-diff: signatures.t + Pl/t/shapes sub-heads.pl; the wide A/B classes are in the session log).  ir-spec §5.2.  Generation v2-13750 (reserved v2-13600, below main after MAIN-READY-87).
GUARD: Pl/t/signatures-arity-01.t rows 19-20 (inverse-verified on main 4a39a1c7).  Probes scratch/s537a/p/m1c m1d m1e = perl.
BARS (the combined tree over MAIN-READY-87, HEAD 7cd511ac): FULL gate 369 / 12,018 -> 12,046 PASS (+ tr-01.t row 9 = 12,047); FULL sweep GATE clean 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST, TOTAL 18,795 -> 18,796 (tr.t +1 = #1493, by edit), drops 5 = census; corpus-diff vs 23f0f917 3 / 111; wide emission A/B 2,053 files 29 DIFF explained / RCDIFF 0; gate-SET scan 638 files IDENTICAL over both populations; ir-host-leak 31 = 31; ir-conform 328 / 0; EVERYDAY 116 -> 116 of 122 (NEW 0); compile time unchanged (Calc.pm 5.52 -> 5.51 s).
